description:
Nice 400ml BPA‑free glass water bottle is a leak‑proof tumbler made for clean, fresh-tasting water—at school, the gym, the office, or on the road. The borosilicate glass keeps every sip crisp with no plastic smell or aftertaste, while the protective plastic shell adds grip and helps guard against everyday knocks in bags and lockers.

Its compact handheld size is easy to carry for kids, teens, and adults. Twist on the secure screw cap, toss it into your backpack, and move through your day without worrying about spills. Use it for plain water, lemon detox, juice, or smoothies. Reusable and eco-friendly, it cuts down single‑use plastic and keeps hydration simple, safe, and satisfying.
